cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI in C# video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看這段使用 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today we're going to look at controlling the reasoning effort on reasoning models like, for example, ChatGPT-5.
cues.zh: 今天要看看如何控制推理模型的推理強度，例如 GPT-5。

cues.en: So, in order to see this best, the best way is to see the difference.
cues.zh: 最容易理解的方法，就是直接比較差異。

cues.en: So, I'm going to quickly set this up so we can run this sample, which is
cues.zh: 先快速設定好，執行這個範例；它也放在

cues.en: in my sample repo that you can get for free on GitHub.
cues.zh: GitHub 的免費範例儲存庫裡。

cues.en: So, I'm just going to get my configuration, and what I'm going to do here as
cues.zh: 先取得組態設定。另外，這裡的

cues.en: well is, in my OpenAI client here, or the Azure OpenAI client, if that's what you're
cues.zh: OpenAIClient，或你使用的 Azure OpenAIClient，

cues.en: using, I'm also setting the network timeout.
cues.zh: 我也設定了網路逾時。

cues.en: You might not need this, but, of course, if you have a reasoning model and you give it a very, very hard question, it can take multiple minutes to actually get an
cues.zh: 不一定每次都需要，但如果推理模型碰到非常難的問題，可能需要好幾分鐘才能

cues.en: answer.
cues.zh: 回答。

cues.en: So, I just included this for the sake of how you do it.
cues.zh: 所以順便展示怎麼設定。

cues.en: You simply just new up, and then there's extra options where you can set the network timeout.
cues.zh: 只要建立用戶端，並透過額外選項設定 NetworkTimeout，

cues.en: So, fairly simple to do.
cues.zh: 操作相當簡單。

cues.en: But why do we need it?
cues.zh: 但為什麼需要它呢？

cues.en: Well, if we, for example, go in and use ChatGPT-5 mini here, and we use
cues.zh: 例如使用這裡的 GPT-5 mini，

cues.en: it without any extra configuration and ask, what is the capital of France and how many
cues.zh: 不提供額外設定，直接問「法國首都是哪裡？那裡有多少

cues.en: people live there?
cues.zh: 人口？」

cues.en: If we do that, it will take a little while to come back because ChatGPT-5 is a reasoning model, and the default, if
cues.zh: 答案會花一點時間，因為 GPT-5 是推理模型，而且如果

cues.en: you don't set anything against many people's belief, is that it's set to medium.
cues.zh: 沒有另外設定，預設其實是 Medium，和很多人的想法不同。

cues.en: There's low, high, medium, and then there's something called minimal, which is the lowest of them all.
cues.zh: 可以選 Low、High、Medium，還有最低的 Minimal。

cues.en: But right now, we have used medium, which means when I write out this answer and show the token count, we can see that
cues.zh: 目前使用的是 Medium。輸出答案並顯示 Token 用量，可以看到，

cues.en: we used 19 tokens for input, but 623 for output, and 512 of these for reasoning.
cues.zh: 輸入只用了 19 個 Token，輸出卻有 623 個，其中 512 個是推理 Token。

cues.en: And reasoning is good if you have a very hard question, but if it's an easy question, then it's not smart to just use
cues.zh: 如果問題很難，推理很好；但簡單問題還要大量

cues.en: reasoning.
cues.zh: 推理，就不太划算。

cues.en: That's the reason why ChatGPT-5, if you give it an easy question, it can answer quickly, but if you give it a hard question, it takes longer.
cues.zh: 所以你在 ChatGPT 使用 GPT-5 時，簡單問題很快回答，困難問題則花比較久，

cues.en: And that's because it's turning on and off the reasoning.
cues.zh: 是因為它會調整是否啟用推理。

cues.en: For the APIs, you can't do that.
cues.zh: 但透過 API，不會直接得到同樣的自動行為，

cues.en: It doesn't happen automatically, so you are in control.
cues.zh: 這裡需要自己控制。

cues.en: But if you just don't care and just run the models, you are actually using the medium reasoning capability.
cues.zh: 如果完全不管，直接執行模型，實際上用的就是 Medium 推理強度。

cues.en: And that might not be what you want, because first of all, it takes longer to give an answer, and second, every token counts,
cues.zh: 這不一定符合需求，因為一來回答變慢，二來每個 Token 都要付費，

cues.en: so you're spending more money on some easy questions.
cues.zh: 所以簡單問題也可能花更多錢。

cues.en: So let's see how we can control this.
cues.zh: 看看該如何控制。

cues.en: And this is unfortunately quite cumbersome in my mind here, because what we do is we
cues.zh: 很可惜，我覺得這裡的設定相當繁瑣，因為首先，

cues.en: make our agent, but then we need to give our options to that, where we need to give a chat client agent options, and inside that we need to give chat options.
cues.zh: 建立代理程式時得傳入 ChatClientAgentOptions，裡面再提供 ChatOptions，

cues.en: And in that, we give a new option where we set this broad representation factory, which
cues.zh: 接著設定 RawRepresentationFactory，

cues.en: can finally set the reasoning effort level to, in my case, minimum.
cues.zh: 最後才能把 ReasoningEffortLevel 設成這裡的 Minimal。

cues.en: But we have the options of minimum, low,
cues.zh: 選項包含 Minimal、Low，

cues.en: medium, which is the default, or high.
cues.zh: 以及預設的 Medium，或 High。

cues.en: And this is specific for OpenAI and Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 這是 OpenAI 和 Azure OpenAI 專用的設定方式。

cues.en: Other models, like Claude and Gemini, does this in completely different ways.
cues.zh: Claude、Gemini 等其他模型，做法完全不同。

cues.en: So what I'm showing is something that only works with Azure OpenAI now, and you need to go in and check documentation of the other models on how you set that for
cues.zh: 所以這裡展示的是 Azure OpenAI 這一套；其他模型需要查看各自文件，確認如何設定

cues.en: that reasoning effort.
cues.zh: 推理強度。

cues.en: So if we do this, we can actually get a response.
cues.zh: 設定好後，就能取得回應。

cues.en: And in my case, I've set it to minimal, which is a new effort they recently introduced, because of this problem of everyone is going to HTTP5, but they also need it
cues.zh: 這裡選 Minimal，這是後來加入的強度，因為大家開始使用 GPT-5，同時又需要

cues.en: for simple answers back.
cues.zh: 處理簡單的問題。

cues.en: And for that, minimal is the best for a reasoning model.
cues.zh: 對於推理模型，Minimal 就適合這種需求。

cues.en: So if we ask exactly the same question, first of all, we should get our answer back faster.
cues.zh: 再問完全相同的問題，首先，回應應該會比較快，

cues.en: Roughly the same answer, but you can see the output tokens are now 64, and zero was used for reasoning.
cues.zh: 答案大致相同，但輸出 Token 現在只有 64 個，推理 Token 是零。

cues.en: And that, of course, is much cheaper and much faster compared to up here.
cues.zh: 比起上面的設定，當然更便宜，也更快。

cues.en: And then you need, of course, to begin to evaluate, is this answer better because we were thinking than this answer?
cues.zh: 接著就需要自行評估：上面經過思考的答案，真的比下面好嗎？

cues.en: And that's not the point here.
cues.zh: 這裡不是要判斷答案品質，

cues.en: You need to know in more real scenarios if you need reasoning or not.
cues.zh: 而是要在真實情境中，知道自己是否需要推理。

cues.en: So you definitely need this if you want to do HTTP5 and do some simple stuff.
cues.zh: 如果想用 GPT-5 處理簡單工作，這個設定很重要。

cues.en: And you definitely need this if you need to set it up to, for example, high and use even more tokens because it's a very advanced thing, like code reviews or something
cues.zh: 如果做的是進階工作，例如程式碼審查，也需要能把它設成 High，允許更多 Token，

cues.en: that is more advanced.
cues.zh: 處理更複雜的事情。

cues.en: As I mentioned, this is Composon.
cues.zh: 如前所述，這個做法很繁瑣，

cues.en: I have actually asked the Agent Framework team about if they want to do something more about this.
cues.zh: 我也問過 Agent Framework 團隊，是否有意讓設定更方便。

cues.en: And right now, the answer is no.
cues.zh: 目前得到的答案是否定的，

cues.en: This is the way you do it.
cues.zh: 這就是目前的設定方式。

cues.en: And the reason for it is that all the different models do it in different ways, and they don't really want to settle in
cues.zh: 原因是不同模型的做法都不同，他們不想過早固定成

cues.en: on one specific way with a string here or because others need to, say, max allow tokens and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 某一種字串設定；其他模型可能要求指定最多允許的 Token 數等等。

cues.en: So right now, they have said, we're not going to fix it, change it.
cues.zh: 因此目前團隊不打算改變這個設計。

cues.en: Again, there's nothing wrong.
cues.zh: 再次強調，這不是功能錯誤，

cues.en: It's just Composon.
cues.zh: 只是使用起來繁瑣，

cues.en: So this is what we need to live with.
cues.zh: 所以目前得接受這個做法。

cues.en: And, of course, what I have done in my case is I have extracted this away because I'm beginning to find more and more
cues.zh: 我自己則把這些細節抽離，因為漸漸發現越來越多設定，

cues.en: things that are not strange, but Composon with the Create AI Agent, there's multiple ways of doing it and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 不是有問題，而是 CreateAIAgent 有太多做法，操作不夠簡潔。

cues.en: So I have made my own Create AI Agent for Azure OpenAI and for OpenAI.
cues.zh: 因此我針對 Azure OpenAI 和 OpenAI，建立自己的 CreateAIAgent。

cues.en: And these are in the repo as well if you want to copy them.
cues.zh: 它們也放在儲存庫裡，需要的話可以複製。

cues.en: And at some point, I might release them as a NuGet package.
cues.zh: 之後也可能發布成 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: But they're down here in my extensions.
cues.zh: 目前放在 Extensions 下面。

cues.en: And what I have made is just a copy of them with a new name.
cues.zh: 實作基本上是複製原有方法，再換個名稱，

cues.en: And here, I'm putting in the reasoning effort so we can abstract this away.
cues.zh: 把 ReasoningEffort 當成參數，隱藏掉這些繁瑣設定。

cues.en: And I also fixed that there is actually a bug in the current one.
cues.zh: 另外也修正當時版本的一個問題：

cues.en: If you set both reasoning and tools at the same time, this is fixing that as well.
cues.zh: 同時設定推理和工具時，這裡也會一併處理。

cues.en: So annoying we need to have this, but I understand the team needs to be generic and work with every single AI model out
cues.zh: 得自己做有點麻煩，但我理解框架團隊需要保持通用，支援各種 AI 模型，

cues.en: there while I can make these for Azure AI and OpenAI which work the same.
cues.zh: 而我可以只針對做法相同的 Azure OpenAI 和 OpenAI 處理。

cues.en: So in my case here, I can then – and this is what I'm going to do in my code – is I'm going to use these new overloads of Create AI
cues.zh: 因此在我的程式裡，接下來會使用這些新的 CreateAIAgent

cues.en: Agents in order to get something simple as this.
cues.zh: 多載，讓程式簡單到像這樣。

cues.en: And it will give exactly the same answer as this one up here.
cues.zh: 結果會和上面那段完全相同。

cues.en: So depending on what you want to do, you use yours.
cues.zh: 依照自己的需求，選擇適合的方式。

cues.en: But just be aware that if you use it raw, it is a bit extra to write in here in order to do it.
cues.zh: 只要記得，直接用原始介面時，這裡需要多寫一些程式碼，

cues.en: So do some kind of abstraction away from it.
cues.zh: 所以可以做一層抽象，

cues.en: Make a helper method, extension method, in my mind.
cues.zh: 我認為可以寫成輔助方法或擴充方法。

cues.en: But that's everything there is to reasoning.
cues.zh: 推理設定就介紹到這裡。

cues.en: The most important thing is, of course, that you remember that any reasoning model by default is medium.
cues.zh: 最重要的是記得，這裡提到的推理模型，預設強度是 Medium。

cues.en: And if you don't do anything about this, this will cost your users a lot of time and you a lot of money based
cues.zh: 如果不處理，可能讓使用者多等很多時間，也讓你支付更多

cues.en: on the tokens if you don't are aware of it at least.
cues.zh: Token 費用；至少要知道這件事。

cues.en: So we're done.
cues.zh: 這段完成了。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝觀看，
